backgroundPolicyCodeReview.classification: Both original lanes are default-config-transparent; ordinary means no CLI switch, not opaque output.
backgroundPolicyCodeReview.cause: Frozen Config.cpp ReadGeneral uses transparent_screenshot default true. Original config inputs omit this key. ApplyOptions ORs config with options.transparent, so both lanes enable VIEWPORT_FLAG_TRANSPARENT_BACKGROUND.
backgroundPolicyCodeReview.pngPolicy: All indexed PNG outputs unconditionally use index0 transparent tRNS; this is independent of viewport background selection.
backgroundPolicyCodeReview.reachableDistinctBehavior: Set existing config transparent_screenshot=false; ordinary paints SPR_BLANK_TILE while --transparent skips it. No new CLI flag or camera is needed in principle; actual distinctive output remains to be run. Both bounded and giant CLI apply this same options path. GUI giant additionally copies main viewport flags.
